description: "Michael Liedtke is an Associated Press reporter covering the Theranos scandal."
"Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani is the former COO of Theranos and ex-boyfriend of Elizabeth Holmes, found guilty of defrauding investors and patients."
"Elizabeth Holmes is the founder and former CEO of Theranos, found guilty of multiple counts of wire fraud and conspiracy to commit fraud."
"Theranos is a failed blood testing startup led by Elizabeth Holmes and Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani."
"San Jose, California is the location where the trials took place."
"Opening Statements mark the beginning of the trials for both Holmes and Balwani."
"Jury Deliberations are the process by which the jury reached their verdicts in the trials."
"Domestic Abuse is a defense strategy Elizabeth Holmes plans to use in her trial."
"Theranos Blood Test refers to the blood testing technology developed by Theranos, which was later found to be fraudulent."
"Federal Wire Fraud is the type of fraud charge that both Holmes and Balwani were found guilty of."
"Conspiracy to Commit Wire Fraud is the type of conspiracy charge that both Holmes and Balwani were found guilty of."
"San Jose Federal Courthouse is the location where the trials took place."
"Steve Jobs is mentioned as a comparison to Elizabeth Holmes, highlighting her fall from grace."
"Silicon Valley Entrepreneur is the role Elizabeth Holmes held before her downfall."
"Tech Industry Icon is the role Elizabeth Holmes held before her downfall."
"Domestic Abuse Defense is the defense strategy Elizabeth Holmes plans to use in her trial."
"Trial Proceedings refer to the legal processes during the trials of Holmes and Balwani."
"Witnesses are the people who testified during the trials, including Holmes herself."
"Potential Jurors are the individuals questioned to determine the final jury members."
"Judge Edward Davila is the judge presiding over the cases of Holmes and Balwani."
"Three-Month Trial is the duration of Elizabeth Holmes' trial."
"Dozens of Witnesses testified during the trials, providing evidence and testimony."
"Live-In Boyfriend is the role Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani held in relation to Elizabeth Holmes."
"Former COO is the role Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani held at Theranos."
"Former President is the role Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani held at Theranos."
"Failed Blood Testing Startup refers to the nature of Theranos and its business model."
"Conviction is the outcome of the trials for both Holmes and Balwani."
"Maximum Sentence is the potential highest sentence for each count of fraud."
"Silicon Valley is the region where Theranos and other tech companies operate."
"Headlines are the news articles and media coverage of the Theranos scandal."
"Disgraced is the term used to describe Elizabeth Holmes' status after the scandal."
"Convicted is the term used to describe the current status of Elizabeth Holmes and Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani."
"Three-Year Downfall refers to the period from the indictment to the conviction of Elizabeth Holmes."
"Two Months is the duration between the conviction of Elizabeth Holmes and the start of Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani's trial."
"Theranos Employees are the staff and employees of Theranos."
"Theranos Patients are the individuals who used Theranos' services."
